title: Taco with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Taco shell - outer curved shape -->
  <path d='M15 65 Q15 35 50 25 Q85 35 85 65 Z' fill='#E8A830' stroke='#F5C95A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Taco shell inner fill (meat) -->
  <path d='M22 62 Q22 40 50 31 Q78 40 78 62 Z' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <!-- Shell texture lines -->
  <path d='M20 58 Q50 48 80 58' fill='none' stroke='#D4942A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M24 50 Q50 41 76 50' fill='none' stroke='#D4942A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Lettuce peeking out left -->
  <path d='M14 65 Q10 55 18 50 Q14 58 20 62 Z' fill='#4CAF50' stroke='#66BB6A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Lettuce right -->
  <path d='M86 65 Q90 55 82 50 Q86 58 80 62 Z' fill='#4CAF50' stroke='#66BB6A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Lettuce top left -->
  <path d='M25 32 Q18 38 22 45 Q26 38 30 35 Z' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Lettuce top right -->
  <path d='M75 32 Q82 38 78 45 Q74 38 70 35 Z' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Tomato bits -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#E53935'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#E53935'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='3' fill='#EF5350'/>
  <!-- Cheese drips -->
  <path d='M35 60 Q38 68 42 60' fill='#FFD54F' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M58 60 Q62 70 66 60' fill='#FFD54F' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Smiling face - eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='4' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='4' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='46.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFECB3'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='46.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFECB3'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40 55 Q50 64 60 55' fill='none' stroke='#3E2723' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
